newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy buys oil service co for $20.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy buys oil service co for $20.6 mln.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc is to buy privately held Well-Co Oil Service Inc for $15.6 million in cash and 400,000 shares, Key said in a statement.

Key also said that it would buy a wellhead equipment rental business and five well service rigs from Tri-State Wellhead & Valve Inc for $550,000 cash and 83,770 shares and signed a letter of intent to buy six well service rigs from Elder Well Service Inc for $609,000.
"The acquisition of Well-Co, Tri-State and Elder will add an additional 93 well service rigs, bringing Key Energy's total well service rig count to 495," Key said.

"As a result of the Well-Co acquisition, combined with Key Energy's existing Permian Basin operations, the company expects to announce additional strategic acquisitions over the next several months," the company said.
